# Fire in the Cave Lab

> Static research laboratory, exploratory models, and navigational frameworks by David Howe. Focuses on systems thinking, self-sovereignty, N=1 experimentation, and cognitive architecture.

## Primary Sections

- [N=1 Experiments](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/): Personal experimentation frameworks for charting unknown professional, physical, and cognitive territory.
  - [Understanding Self](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/self.html): Foundational baseline mapping, internal drivers, and biomarker telemetry.
  - [Preparation](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/preparation.html): Tooling, mental models, and provision architecture for navigating uncharted domains.
  - [Sailing the Open Sea](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/sailing_open_sea.html): Liminal phase dynamics and operational autonomy.
  - [Mapping the Paths](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/n-1-experiments/mapping_journey.html): Pattern convergence, tracking datasets, and navigational logs.

## Long-Form Essays & Shards

- [Essays Archive](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/essays/essays.html): Primary philosophical and systems dynamics publications.

## Optional & Full Context

- [Full Content Ingestion](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/llms-full.txt): Complete raw markdown archive for single-prompt context loading.

## Advisory & Technical Engagements
- [Collaborations & Advisory](https://lab.fireinthecave.com/collaborations.html): High-context advisory, local AI infrastructure sovereignty, and multi-domain decision models for technical founders and independent practitioners.

## Products & Toolkits
- [Research Vault Subscription](https://www.fireinthecave.com/#/portal/signup): Full access to paid dispatches and quarterly dossiers.
